stem: How do the frogs in the selection “Tiptoeing Scientists” differ from the octopod in the selection “A Ghostly New Creature”?

options.label: F
options.text: The frogs’ bodies have coloration that protects the frogs. The octopod’s body does not have coloration for protection.

options.label: G
options.text: The frogs are found on islands in the Pacific Ocean near Hawaii. The octopod was sighted off the coast of Brazil in South America.

options.label: H
options.text: The frogs’ size is typical for its species. The octopod’s size is smaller than normal.

options.label: J
options.text: The frogs are well adapted to their environment. The octopod has not adapted to its environment.
